title: KP Flink Jobs Metrics
description: Real Flink jobs only, confirmed against the actual chart config (helmcharts/knowledgebb/charts/flink+py-flink, helmcharts/learnbb/charts/flink) and live cluster pods. KP = knowledgebb (5 jobs), LP = learnbb (3 jobs), 8 total. Collection Certificate Generator's panels are fully verified (metric names read directly from this dashboard's own pre-existing working content). The other 7 jobs' Total/Success/Skipped/Failed Events panels follow the same flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_<job>_<metric> naming convention confirmed across 4 other jobs in this framework, but are NOT independently confirmed for these specific job names -- verify against a running Prometheus instance (or the pod's own /metrics endpoint) once deployed. Every job's Lag panel uses the universal Flink Kafka-consumer metric, which is guaranteed real for any Flink job.
